My eating habits have been so awesome this week!! I didn’t skip any meals and I actually made sure to make things to eat rather than just grabbing random snacks!

Finally taking that LEAP and living a plant-based lifestyle was one of the best decisions I’ve made!! I put it off for 4 yrs...there’s so many options plus I feel so much better!! 😌😋💪🏽🍏🍐🍋🍇🍓🍍🥝🍅🥑🥦🥒🌶🌽🥕🍠🍞🥗🍚🥔🍊🍑#tofu #soymilk #cashews etc.

I’ve always had a habit of skipping meals and some days I would make up for the meals I skipped that day. Other days I didn’t so my body would hold on to what I ate last unsure of the next time it would be fed. As a vegan I have to eat throughout the day. No way around it.

Plus I’ve always been a shy/quiet person so looking people directly in the eyes just wasn’t my thing. On top of all of that I was doing good in school. Yeah, I had thoughts of killing myself and attempted to a few times, but I never shared that with anybody. ...

When I graduated from undergrad I decided I wasn’t gonna hide who I am and act like my degree means I have to care myself a different way. Yes, I have degrees, but I’m still free spirited, goofy, kreative in every fiber of my body, and have so many layers to me!
